questions.question: Who is the new, younger speaker introduced in chapter 32?
Why was Elihu angry?
options: At Job for endlessly boasting of all the great wealth he once had
At the violent storm that had swept away the whole of the harvest
At God himself for allowing such a truly righteous man to suffer so terribly
At Job for justifying himself, and at the friends for finding no answer
questions.answer: At Job for justifying himself, and at the friends for finding no answer

questions.question: Elihu had waited to speak because the others were older than he.
Elihu said it is the _____ in a man, the breath of the Almighty, that gives understanding.
Elihu said he was full of words and the spirit within him constrained him, like new _____ ready to burst.
